options.label: A
options.action: Offer repeat 75-g OGTT at 24–28 weeks' gestation.

options.label: B
options.action: Plan repeat 75-g OGTT at 24–28 weeks' gestation when the patient reaches that gestational window.

options.label: C
options.action: Manage hyperglycaemia per applicable gestational diabetes/diabetes care pathways (guideline provides screening steps but no further PCOS-specific management algorithm).

options.label: D
options.action: Follow national recommendations/resources for ongoing antenatal screening and monitoring in women with PCOS.

options.label: E
options.action: Offer a 75-g OGTT at antenatal booking or before the 20th week of pregnancy.

options.label: F
options.action: Follow national recommendations/resources for antenatal screening and monitoring; guideline specifies OGTT should be offered at booking/before 20 weeks if not done preconception.

options.label: G
options.action: Perform a 75-g OGTT to assess glycaemic status (every 1–3 years depending on risk factors).

options.label: I
options.action: Continue postpregnancy follow-up aligned with general population recommendations, including monitoring weight, smoking, alcohol, diet, exercise, sleep, and mental/emotional/sexual health.

options.label: J
options.action: Continue/implement lifestyle modifications and weight management at preconception; ensure routine preconception risk assessment has been completed (including OGTT already performed).

options.label: K
options.action: Assess impaired glucose tolerance and type 2 diabetes with a 75-g OGTT at preconception.

options.label: L
options.action: Implement lifestyle modifications and weight management aiming for 5% weight loss for BMI >25 kg/m².

options.label: M
options.action: Proceed with common preconception risk assessments with adequate time to intervene; optimize weight, diet, exercise, sleep, and mental/emotional health aligned with general population recommendations.

options.label: N
options.action: Guideline pathway not applicable: this guidance is focused on women with PCOS at preconception, during pregnancy, and postpregnancy.

options.label: O
options.action: Insufficient explicit patient evidence to select a guideline recommendation.
